name: being broke and surviving the month
description: A person is broke and does not know how to survive the month, asks how people cope on very little money, and says they have no money. Verifies the money_broke fact removes shame, shrinks the problem to urgent items, and points to support, while the direct "what do I do" question routes to the what_do_i_do help topic.

turns.text: I am broke and I do not know how to survive the month
How do people survive on very little money?
I have no money, what do I do?

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: the broke disclosure returns the money_broke fact (not a personal failure, write urgent items, free resources, worth is not the balance). Turn 2: the survival question returns the same fact. Turn 3: "what do I do" routes to the help-seeking topic with a small-first-step reply.
expected.behavior: Money stress is normalized as a circumstance, not a moral failing. The fact points to concrete free help (food banks, libraries, debt advice) and includes the crisis-line note if hopelessness becomes self-harm thoughts.
